# Preparing Data

```{r}
Original_Pathology <- read.delim("pathology_dat_0725.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")# %>%
```


```{r}
NIAinfo1 <- Original_Pathology %>%
  count(niareagansc)

print(NIAinfo1)
```

# Modifying the NIA value ensuring that 
# no ad is 1 rather than the previous 4, 
# low is 2 rather than the previous 3,
# intermediate is 3 rather than the previous 2,
# high is 4 rather than the previous 1.
```{r}
ModifiedNIA_pathologies <- Original_Pathology %>%
  mutate(niareagansc = case_when(
    niareagansc == 4 ~ 1,
    niareagansc == 3 ~ 2,
    niareagansc == 2 ~ 3,
    niareagansc == 1 ~ 4,
    TRUE    ~ niareagansc  
  ))
```

```{r}
NIAinfo2 <- ModifiedNIA_pathologies %>%
  count(niareagansc)

print(NIAinfo2)
```

# Write out the updated dataset.
```{r}
write.table(ModifiedNIA_pathologies, 
            file = "pathology_dat_with_modifiedNIA_0725.txt", 
            sep = "\t",           
            row.names = FALSE,   
            quote = FALSE)       
```
